# Technology, Magic & Items

## A Mad Love {#a-mad-love}

"A Mad Love" is a newspaper story spanning one hundred and three chapters that follows a long-delayed wedding and is read by Captain Jim.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P22](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P24](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P25](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0025), +23 more_

## Averil’s Atonement {#averil-s-atonement}

Averil's Atonement is a story with a plot written by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) that was rejected by both an [American](../codex/factions.md#american) magazine editor and the editor of the [Canadian Woman](../codex/factions.md#canadian-woman).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P63](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0063), [v3 ch.Atonement” P64](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0064), [v3 ch.Atonement” P65](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0065), [v3 ch.Atonement” P66](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0066), +14 more_

## Four Sisters {#four-sisters}

The Four Sisters was a sea vessel that sailed to [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana) with [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) and [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) aboard before disappearing on its return journey.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P25](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), +10 more_
